name: inbox.set-self-chat-mute
description: Set the mute state of one preflighted self-chat by changing only ChatSetting.IS_REMIND. expectedMuted is a stale-state guard for the parent bridge and is never sent. Parent must confirm self-chat identity, force-read before and after, roll back to the exact prior state after a fixture check, and never retry a write automatically.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: Canonical native chat ID from inbox.chat-mute-state after self-chat identity preflight.

parameters.name: muted
parameters.description: Requested state: 1 mutes and 0 restores reminders.

parameters.name: expectedMuted
parameters.description: Current 0 or 1 state read immediately before apply; bridge compares it to prevent a stale write.

evidence.snippet: Generated chats.PatchChatSettingRequest: required chatId, chatSetting, repeated updateChatSettingField; no broad Chat payload.
Generated entities.ChatSetting fields include isRemind id=1; Field.IS_REMIND=1.
Desktop updateChatSetting builds PatchChatSettingRequest with chatSetting.isRemind and updateChatSettingField.push(IS_REMIND), then calls native command.
Native command table maps 60 to chats.PatchChatSettingRequest and chats.PatchChatSettingResponse.
